2607.17917.title: PEARL: Auditable Repair for Scientific Reasoning Graph Extraction
2607.17917.paper_summary: Scientific Reasoning Graph Extraction (SRGE) aims to recover explicit links among observations, evidence, intermediate claims, and paper-level conclusions. LLMs can produce graph-like scientific explanations, but their outputs often mix malformed syntax, drifting edge labels, incorrectly oriented roots, and weak source anchors. We propose PEARL (Peircean Extraction via Abstraction and Repair Layer), a training-free framework that turns noisy LLM graph responses into auditable reasoning graphs and repairs them toward strict semantic validity. PEARL first materializes explicit graph content under a closed Peircean schema, then uses matched evidence-grounded judge feedback to repair rejected edge types, local inference steps, and terminal roots while preserving an audit trail. On five 70-paper model archives from ARCHE, a benchmark for latent reasoning-chain extraction, PEARL raises strict gate passes from 0/350 for the LLM baseline to 300/350, with average REA improving from 0.339 to 0.906. The graphs provide a reliability layer for research-agent and AI scientist workflows that need inspectable reasoning traces rather than unconstrained graph regeneration. Code and audit artifacts are available at https://github.com/BohanSu/auditable-repair-reasoning-graphs/tree/300-350_workshop .
2607.17917.paper_summary_zh: 科學推理圖提取（SRGE）旨在恢復觀察、證據、中介主張和論文級結論之間的明確聯繫。大型語言模型（LLMs）可以生成類似圖形的科學解釋，但其輸出往往混合了不良的語法、漂移的邊標籤、錯誤定向的根部和薄弱的來源錨點。我們提出了PEARL（透過抽象和修復層的皮爾士提取），這是一個無需訓練的框架，將嘈雜的LLM圖形響應轉換為可審計的推理圖，並朝著嚴格的語義有效性進行修復。PEARL首先在封閉的皮爾士架構下具現化明確的圖形內容，然後使用匹配的基於證據的評判反饋來修復被拒絕的邊類型、本地推理步驟和終端根，同時保留審計記錄。在來自ARCHE的五個70篇論文模型檔案上，作為潛在推理鏈提取的基準，PEARL將嚴格的通過率從LLM基線的0/350提升至300/350，平均REA從0.339提高至0.906。這些圖形為需要可檢查推理痕跡而非不受限制圖形再生的研究代理和AI科學家工作流程提供了可靠性層。代碼和審計文檔可在https://github.com/BohanSu/auditable-repair-reasoning-graphs/tree/300-350_workshop 獲得。
